subject: Home prices: your home today and your 2030 plan
draft: Samantha, home prices in major US markets are up 6% over the past year. Two sides of that touch your plan. Your home, valued at $900,000 and fully owned, is most of your wealth. And you're planning a second home purchase of $500,000 in 2030, which could cost more if prices keep rising. That purchase competes with college for Ethan and Ava and with retirement saving, and only $750 of your cash sits above your reserve and near-term goals. No action is needed now; at our next review, let's revisit the 2030 budget alongside college costs.
voice_script: Hi Samantha, it's Mohamed. Home prices are up, which lifts the value of your home and may raise the cost of the one you plan for 2030. Nothing to do now; let's revisit that budget alongside college costs at our next review.
